displayIdentity.body: Paul calls readers to be strong in the Lord and put on God’s whole armor against the devil’s schemes. He names rulers and spiritual forces. He then calls them to stand with truth, righteousness, peace, faith, salvation, God’s word, prayer, and bold speech.
displayIdentity.title: The whole armor of God answers the devil’s schemes
